description: SYNTHORA ecb-macro: official eurozone macro from the ECB data warehouse — HICP inflation, MRR policy rate, 10Y govt yield, each with previous value, change and direction. For macro/rates agents and prediction markets. Official free source, no key. $0.03 USDC x402 Base. [x402: 0.03 USDC per call on Base]

mode.description: Compatibility field constrained to latest by the public schema. The currently routed backend ignores it and requests the last two observations of each fixed series. It provides no selectable date/history mode; latest is not a live-feed or freshness guarantee.

region.description: Compatibility field constrained to U2 by the public schema. The currently routed backend ignores this argument and requests its three fixed Euro-area (U2) ECB series; it cannot select another region.

name: ecb_macro
